description: Java interface defining policy-related events within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for accessing policy identifiers, schema versions, and headers, and includes nested class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: PolicyEvent
classes.description: Interface for all policy-related events, extending the generic Event interface with methods specific to policy entities.

classes.name: PolicyEvent.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions related to PolicyEvent, specifically 'policyId'.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns an array containing the supported JsonSchemaVersion(s), specifically V_2.

methods.name: getPolicyId
methods.description: Deprecated method returning the Policy ID as a String based on the entity ID.

methods.name: getPolicyEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId object for this event.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Provides the resource type string, which is 'policy'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets Ditto headers on the event, returning the modified event.
